推荐各位书友阅读：为了长生不死，我带着全宗修仙第226章冤家路窄（..la）风灵宗独占好几座山头，山脚下还有不少城镇，按规矩，弟子们其实是不能轻易下山的。
但这种规矩也只是写在书面上的，有人偷偷下山的话，也没人去管。
修仙是个人的事情，自己不上进，就别怪被其他人远远超过。
这几座城镇发展规模不小，里面主要进行灵石交易，且店铺绝大多数由修士开设。
“那就好！”闻言，破天也不由得点了点头，一斧头，将面前的一只蛮族尸人击飞出去。
卡琳娜和梅利两人聊天的时候，苏阳和刘诗雅两人也正在卧室内聊天。
王辉知道，苏阳是说到就会做到的。所以，他也不想去劝苏阳，觉得也没必要劝。因为苏阳做的是对的。他要是有苏阳这样强大的实力，也会像苏阳一样。不会受任何人欺负。
剑上一片幽暗色泽，俨然淬有剧毒。而使剑者挑选的时机，更是恰到好处。
“这和我们约定好的不一样。”祖恭沙哑着嗓子，看着缓缓走来的陆茹说道。
大明尊笑着，神色却陡然一凛，楚风的神色也在刹那之间变得异常的凝重。
到了时光走廊酒吧，王辉为了不让人去骚扰卡琳娜和刘诗雅，派虎子给酒吧里的男人都打了招呼。
冰之祺虽没有中年男人想得那般多，但是却也不得不分心照应着离绾，所以攻势并不如他以往的一般大开大合，而是每一招都留了后手，随时准备着挽回离绾的劣势。
“因为真正开枪的人不是我，而是水珊瑚。我死了之后，鹰眼一定会让她来接替我追杀你。她早就已经被鹰眼所控制，我就不相信她会放过你。
“我要救那些被血龙族抓进去的孩童，你要的是九星问天大阵，我们自然可以合作共同谋利，毕竟目标都是血龙族！”李江说道。
龙芷茹看向那巨人至尊，以她的境界自然看得出那巨人至尊的境界，而且让凤屏这位至尊向自己求救，足以说明此人实力之强，龙芷茹实力恰强大，根本不是凤屏能比的，这也是凤屏向龙芷茹求救的原因。
而就在两人交战没多久，天空中来了一个身穿紫金长袍的少年人。
这些人正是来自金钱帮的钱二还有古巫族的曾天宿他们，此刻看到四周被破坏的大地还有机器絮乱的天空便可知道刚刚辰南和那头巨猿的战斗有多么强大。
“林虎，怎么回事？明儿是谁杀的？”司徒木眼睛盯着司徒明的尸体，开口询问道，声音不大，却带着无比的杀机。

“好了，你在此修炼吧，时间到了我自会叫你出去的！”秦山说完从李江面前消失。
所以，他们心念一动，随着一阵白色的光芒一闪而过，两人消失了。
当他们开始了越级战，十多人也学着问心七人那般，围成圈的交流了起来。
吕玄被仁中龙一击得手，猛地喷出一口鲜血，一时间喷了云万花一脸一身。
李慧美紧捂住被李秀满打的通红的脸颊，脸上还有很明显的巴掌红印，李慧美惊呆了，没有想到李秀满竟然会打她，眼眶瞬间湿润了，瞪着李秀满，眼中充满了仇恨。
“还有陌上也过来了，也在外面镇守，在张奶奶那边。”百里云飞继续说道。
见着面前的这些事情，所有的奴婢奴才也都是纷纷议论了起来，在沈府这么多年都还没有发生过这样的事情呢，也不知道老夫人和老爷若是知道了，能否接受的了，不过看着长乐公主的意思，也没有打算把他们放在眼里的。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: In order to live forever, I took the whole sect to cultivate immortality Chapter 226: Enemies on the Narrow Road (..la) The Fengling Sect occupies several mountain tops exclusively, and there are many towns at the foot of the mountains. According to the rules, the disciples cannot go down the mountain easily.
But this kind of rule is only written in writing. If someone sneaks down the mountain, no one will care.
Cultivation of immortality is a personal matter. If you don't make progress, don't blame yourself for being far surpassed by others.
The development scale of these towns is not small. They mainly trade spiritual stones, and most of the shops are opened by monks.
"That's good!" Hearing this, Potian couldn't help but nodded, and with an axe, he knocked away a barbarian corpse in front of him.
While Karina and Meili were chatting, Su Yang and Liu Shiya were also chatting in the bedroom.
Wang Hui knew that Su Yang would do what he said. Therefore, he did not want to persuade Su Yang, and felt that there was no need to do so. Because Su Yang did the right thing. If he were as powerful as Su Yang, he would be like Su Yang. Will not be bullied by anyone.
The sword had a dark color, as if it was quenched with poison. The timing chosen by the sword wielder was even more perfect.
"This is different from what we agreed." Zu Gong said in a hoarse voice, looking at Lu Ru who was walking slowly.
Da Mingzun smiled, but his expression suddenly became stern, and Chu Feng's expression also became unusually solemn in an instant.
When they arrived at the Time Corridor Bar, Wang Hui sent Huzi to greet all the men in the bar in order to prevent others from harassing Karina and Liu Shiya.
Although Bing Zhiqi didn't think as much as the middle-aged man thought, he still had to focus on taking care of Li Wan, so his offensive was not as broad as he used to, but he had a backhand in every move, ready to restore Li Wan's disadvantage at any time.
"Because the one who really shot was not me, but Aqua Coral. After I die, Hawkeye will definitely let her take over my place to hunt you down. She has been controlled by Hawkeye for a long time, and I don't believe she will let you go.
"I want to save the children who were captured by the Blood Dragon Clan. What you want is the Nine-Star Wentian Formation. We can naturally cooperate and make profits together. After all, the targets are all the Blood Dragon Clan! "Li Jiang said.
Long Zhiru looked at the giant supreme. From her level, she could naturally tell the giant supreme's state. And letting Fengping, the supreme, ask for help from her was enough to show how strong this person was. Long Zhiru was just too powerful, not even comparable to Fengping. This was why Fengping asked Long Zhiru for help.
Not long after the two men fought, a young man wearing a purple and gold robe appeared in the sky.
These people are Qian Er from the Money Gang and Zeng Tiansu from the Ancient Witch Clan. At this moment, looking at the destroyed land and the machine-jammed sky, one can know how powerful the battle between Chen Nan and the giant ape just now was.
“Lin Hu, what’s going on? Who will kill tomorrow? "Situ Mu stared at Situ Ming's body and asked, his voice not loud, but with incomparable murderous intent.
"Okay, you can practice here, I will ask you out when the time is up! "After Qin Shan finished speaking, he disappeared from Li Jiang.
So, with a thought in their minds, with a flash of white light, the two of them disappeared.
When they started the leapfrog battle, more than ten people also followed the example of the seven people who asked their hearts and formed a circle to communicate.
Lu Xuan was hit by Ren Zhonglong and suddenly spurted out a mouthful of blood, all over Yun Wanhua's face and body.
Li Huimei tightly covered her red cheeks that were slapped by Li Xiuman, and there were obvious red marks on her face. Li Huimei was shocked. She didn't expect that Li Xiuman would hit her. Her eyes instantly became moist, and she stared at Li Xiuman, her eyes filled with hatred.
"Mo Shang also came over and was also guarding outside, at Grandma Zhang's side. "Baili Yunfei continued.
Seeing these things in front of them, all the servants and servants started talking about it. Such a thing has never happened in Shen Mansion for so many years. I don't know if the old lady and the master would accept it if they knew about it. However, looking at Princess Changle's intention, she had no intention of taking them seriously. ..la
